from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,importlib.util,re
r=Path('/mnt/d/home/source/zig/forthz');o=r/'.work/local-call-20261116';exe=r/'.work/rot3-20261116/baseline-symbols/bin/sigma'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('parse',r/'.work/memory-access-20261116/parse-callgrind.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='af54c4a8b252be6a15480fa1b770e960001e4861c84b1db5eff95a6b5ed6c910'
drivers=[line.split()[-1] for line in subprocess.check_output(['nm','-n',str(exe)],text=True).splitlines() if 'forth.State.runOperations__' in line];assert len(drivers)==2
cases={
'literal':(': HOT 0 N 0 DO 7 + LOOP ; HOT .',lambda n:7*n),
'cell-fetch':(': HOT { x -- } 0 N 0 DO x + LOOP ; 7 HOT .',lambda n:7*n),
'cell-store':(': HOT { | x -- } N 0 DO I TO x LOOP x ; HOT .',lambda n:n-1),
'char-fetch':(': HOT { C: x -- } 0 N 0 DO x + LOOP ; 263 HOT .',lambda n:7*n),
'double-fetch':(': HOT { D: x -- } 0. N 0 DO x D+ LOOP ; 7. HOT D.',lambda n:7*n),
'float-fetch':(': HOT { F: x -- } 0E N 0 DO x F+ LOOP ; 7E HOT F>S .',lambda n:7*n),
'xt-execute':(': ACTION 7 ; : HOT { XT: action -- } 0 N 0 DO action + LOOP ; \' ACTION HOT .',lambda n:7*n),
'constant-call':('7 CONSTANT VALUE-X : HOT 0 N 0 DO VALUE-X + LOOP ; HOT .',lambda n:7*n),
'value-call':('7 VALUE VALUE-X : HOT 0 N 0 DO VALUE-X + LOOP ; HOT .',lambda n:7*n),
'created-call':('CREATE VALUE-X 7 , : HOT 0 N 0 DO VALUE-X @ + LOOP ; HOT .',lambda n:7*n),
'colon-call':(': ACTION 7 + ; : HOT 0 N 0 DO ACTION LOOP ; HOT .',lambda n:7*n),
'deferred-colon':(': ACTION 7 + ; DEFER TARGET \' ACTION IS TARGET : HOT 0 N 0 DO TARGET LOOP ; HOT .',lambda n:7*n),
}
report={'scope':'Adopted-source Linux symbols fast baseline CPU uncounted; 100/200 Callgrind delta; not timing. Loop and operand overhead included.','binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'cases':{}}
if (o/'linux-results.json').exists():report=json.loads((o/'linux-results.json').read_text())
for name,(body,expected) in cases.items():
 if name in report['cases']:continue
 profiles=[];commands=[]
 for n in [100,200]:
  source=f'{n} CONSTANT LOCAL-PROBE-ITERATIONS '+body.replace(' N ',' LOCAL-PROBE-ITERATIONS ')+' DEPTH . BYE';args=[str(exe),'-e',source]
  p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True);assert p.returncode==0 and p.stdout.split()==[str(expected(n)).encode(),b'0'],(name,n,p.stdout,p.stderr)
  output=o/f'{name}-{n}.callgrind';cmd=['valgrind','--tool=callgrind','--collect-atstart=no','--toggle-collect='+drivers[0],'--cache-sim=yes','--dump-instr=yes','--dump-line=no','--callgrind-out-file='+str(output),*args]
  p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True);assert p.returncode==0 and p.stdout.split()==[str(expected(n)).encode(),b'0']
  (o/f'{name}-{n}.log').write_bytes(p.stdout+b'\n'+p.stderr);profiles.append(m.parse(output));commands.append(cmd)
 a,b=profiles
 delta={k:(b['summary'][k]-a['summary'][k])/100 for k in ['Ir','Dr','Dw']}
 calls={k:(b['calls'].get(k,0)-a['calls'].get(k,0))/100 for k in a['calls'].keys()|b['calls'].keys()};calls={k:v for k,v in calls.items() if v}
 own={k:{e:(b['self_counts'].get(k,{}).get(e,0)-a['self_counts'].get(k,{}).get(e,0))/100 for e in ['Ir','Dr','Dw']} for k in a['self_counts'].keys()|b['self_counts'].keys()};own={k:v for k,v in own.items() if v['Ir']}
 report['cases'][name]={'body':body,'commands':commands,'per_iteration':delta,'calls':calls,'self_counts':own,'profiles':profiles}
 (o/'linux-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(name,delta,{k:v for k,v in own.items() if 'Local' in k},flush=True)
report['script']=Path(__file__).read_text();(o/'linux-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
